steps.title: Dialogues
steps.body: Listen for who is speaking, what they do and the time in their schedule. The speakers use vous when they first meet and tu after they agree to use it.

steps.title: Meeting the manager
steps.body: A new employee meets his manager on his first day.

examples.fr: Bonjour. Je m'appelle Sam. C'est mon premier jour.
examples.en: Employé: Hello. My name is Sam. It is my first day.

examples.fr: Bonjour Sam. Je suis Karine, la gérante. Bienvenue !
examples.en: Karine: Hello, Sam. I am Karine, the manager. Welcome!

examples.fr: Merci. Je commence à huit heures ?
examples.en: Sam: Thank you. Do I start at eight o'clock?

examples.fr: Oui. Votre horaire est ici. La pause est à midi.
examples.en: Karine: Yes. Your schedule is here. The break is at noon.

examples.fr: Et à quelle heure est la réunion ?
examples.en: Sam: And what time is the meeting?

examples.fr: À neuf heures. Voici votre bureau.
examples.en: Karine: At nine o'clock. Here is your office.

examples.fr: Merci, madame. Je suis content d'être ici.
examples.en: Sam: Thank you, ma'am. I am happy to be here.
Karine: You can call me Karine.

steps.title: Talking about work and school
steps.body: Two coworkers discuss their jobs and studies.

examples.fr: Non, je travaille à temps partiel. J'étudie au cégep.
examples.en: Nadia: No, I work part-time. I study at a cégep.

examples.fr: Un cours de français. Et toi, tu travailles où ?
examples.en: Nadia: A French class. And you, where do you work?

examples.fr: Je travaille dans une entreprise. Je finis à seize heures.
examples.en: Sam: I work at a company. I finish at four p.m.

examples.fr: Moi, je finis mon cours à quinze heures.
examples.en: Nadia: I finish my class at three p.m.

steps.explain: Karine says she is la gérante, the manager.

steps.prompt: At what time is the break?
steps.explain: Karine says La pause est à midi.

steps.prompt: What time does Sam finish work?
steps.explain: Sam says Je finis à seize heures.
